title: Grand Opening
morning_note: Grand opening! Listen for hint words, then pick 2 ingredients.

title: Word Gets Around
morning_note: Five new potions today! Listen for the hint words: they point the way.

title: The Guild Comes Calling
morning_note: Moonmoss is in: grind it in the mortar! And a Guild inspector is in town.

lines.great: Calm, clear and correct. Your shop passes stage one.
lines.poor: Hm. Unsteady. Stage one: marked 'concerning'.
lines.refused: Refusing the Guild? That goes in the file.
lines.stormed_off: Late. The Guild does not wait. Stage one: failed.

lines.great: Oh! The tickle's gone. Thank you... I'll remember this.
lines.poor: Still tickly... ahh... sorry about the smoke.
lines.refused: Oh. Sorry to bother you. *sniff*
lines.stormed_off: I... I have to go. Ahh... AHH... sorry!

title: Garden Party
morning_note: Garden party! Green thumbs and night owls drop by all day.

morning_notes.text: A hooded stranger has been praising you. Garden party today!

title: Paperwork
morning_note: Inspector Quill is back with forms. So many forms.

lines.great: Asleep in four minutes. Your file grows... favourably.
lines.poor: I stayed up all night. Form 27-B now has a stain.
lines.refused: No help with my forms? Noted. On a form.
lines.stormed_off: I've wasted an hour. That is three forms' worth.

title: Rival Across the Street
morning_note: Cinderroot is in! Pump the bellows to wake its fire. Who opened that shop?

lines.great: Hm! Not bad, neighbour. Not bad at all. Watch your back.
lines.poor: As I thought. Customers will flock to me. Ta-ta!
lines.refused: Too scared to brew for me? Delightful. Ciao!
lines.stormed_off: I waited. I never wait. You'll pay for that.

title: Smoke Signals
morning_note: Two fiery new potions. Something outside keeps hiccuping.

morning_notes.text: Vexley's queue is spilling over to you! Two fiery new potions.

lines.great: Hic... oh! They stopped! And nothing's on fire!
lines.poor: Hic! Sorry about your curtains. Hic!
lines.refused: Hic... I'll go hiccup somewhere less flammable.
lines.stormed_off: HIC! Oh no, the bench. Sorry! Bye!

title: The Audit
morning_note: Audit day. Inspector Quill brought his longest quill.

morning_notes.text: The inspector speaks well of you. Audit today: nerves of steel!
The Guild inspector is back for a re-inspection. Look sharp.

lines.great: Flawless, under audit. I'm recommending you.
lines.poor: Hot-headed. The fire won, the cool head lost. Noted.
lines.refused: Refusing an auditor. Bold. Recorded.
lines.stormed_off: Auditors keep the clock, not you. Audit failed.

lines.great: Much better. I'll amend the file. In pen.
lines.poor: Still shaky. My report grows longer.
lines.refused: No second chance taken? So be it.
lines.stormed_off: I waited. The Guild does not wait twice.

title: Market Day Rush
morning_note: Market day! More customers, less patience. Brew fast, smile faster.

lines.great: Hmph. It's... excellent. I mean, for research.
lines.poor: Ha! Amateur work. My notes will be brief.
lines.refused: Refused? I'm a paying customer! In disguise!
lines.stormed_off: Too slow! A spy has a schedule, you know.

title: Flying Lessons
morning_note: A quiet day. Someone on the roof is practising... flapping?

lines.great: Steady wings! Off to fly round the mill. Well, half.
lines.poor: Still wobbly. I'll aim for the duck pond.
lines.refused: Oh. Maybe I'll just walk. Like a person.
lines.stormed_off: The lesson's starting... I'll go nervous, then.

title: Surprise Inspection
morning_note: Snowfire pearls in stock: fire and frost in one cold little gem.

lines.great: Spotless. I'm not supposed to smile on duty. I'm not.
lines.poor: Lukewarm in every sense. Noted, in red ink.
lines.refused: Turning away an inspector? Bold. Very bold.
lines.stormed_off: A surprise inspection and you're the slow one. Hm.

title: Night Garden
morning_note: Twilight blooms are in! Two rare potions, and Vexley's roses glow.

lines.great: My roses glow purple! The neighbours are terrified. Perfect.
lines.poor: They're glowing... beige. Beige, darling.
lines.refused: Fine. I'll make my roses spooky myself.
lines.stormed_off: My roses wilted while I waited. Thanks.

title: Starlight
morning_note: Starlight dew at the market: grind it fine! The hooded stranger lingers.

lines.great: No sparks! You kept my secret AND my fire. Friend!
lines.poor: It flickers still... but you didn't run. Thank you.
lines.refused: I see... a dragon is too much. I understand.
lines.stormed_off: Never mind... I shouldn't have said anything.

lines.great: Better... Maybe I'll tell you my secret one day.
lines.poor: Still tickly. I'd better keep my hood up.
lines.refused: That's alright... I'll manage. Somehow.
lines.stormed_off: I'll go... before something catches fire.

title: The Truce
morning_note: Rare goods are flying off the shelves. Vexley is on her way over.

morning_notes.text: Smoke over Vexley's shop! Something has gone very wrong.
Vexley tells everyone you're a fraud. She's coming to prove it.

lines.great: You saved my shop. Truce? Truce. Don't get used to it.
lines.poor: It fizzled. Well... thank you for trying. I suppose.
lines.refused: Fine! I'll fix it alone. Like always.
lines.stormed_off: Never mind! I'll find someone who answers the door.

lines.great: You... did it? Hmph. Perhaps I misjudged you.
lines.poor: Ha! I knew it. See you at the Fair, amateur.
lines.refused: Chicken! I'll tell the whole Fair.
lines.stormed_off: Too slow, darling! The Fair will hear of this.

title: Festival Eve Rush
morning_note: The Fair is near and the village is buzzing. Busy, busy, busy!

morning_notes.text: A dragon was seen lighting the bakery ovens. The village is buzzing!

title: Lantern Practice
morning_note: The Fair lanterns arrive. Someone small and scaly offers to help.

lines.great: Look! One lantern, no tent fire. I am ready!
lines.poor: The lantern's lit. So is my hood. Again.
lines.refused: I'll practise on candles. Small ones.
lines.stormed_off: The lanterns went home without me.

title: Dress Rehearsal
morning_note: Inspector Quill wants a rehearsal of the Fair test.

morning_notes.text: Quill wants a Fair rehearsal. 'A formality,' he says. Twice.
Quill wants a Fair rehearsal. 'Last chance,' he says, kindly.

lines.great: Flawless rehearsal. Please do exactly that again.
lines.poor: If that happens at the Fair, I'll need a bigger form.
lines.refused: No rehearsal? Then pray the Fair goes well.
lines.stormed_off: Rehearsals start on time. This one did not.

title: Recipe Swap
morning_note: Vexley knocks with a notebook and a suspicious smile.

morning_notes.text: Vexley offers to swap recipes. Partners share, darling!

lines.great: Here's mine: add a wink. You're welcome, partner.
lines.poor: Hm. I'll keep my recipe, I think.
lines.refused: No swap? Your loss, darling. Truly.
lines.stormed_off: I had a recipe for you. Had.

title: Calm Before the Fair
morning_note: The Guild Fair is tomorrow! Stock up well tonight. Breathe.

title: The Guild Fair
morning_note: The Guild Fair! Everyone you've met is here. The licence is decided today.

morning_notes.text: The Guild Fair! Inspector Quill hints that your licence looks likely.

lines.great: The crowd adores it! Partners? Partners, darling!
lines.poor: Hm, the crowd's lukewarm. Next year, partner.
lines.refused: You'd leave our stall empty? Oh. I see.
lines.stormed_off: The stall's closing! Where's my showpiece?

lines.great: You win, darling. Rivals... and maybe friends?
lines.poor: Victory is mine! Still... thanks for the duel.
lines.refused: Forfeit! The duel goes to Vexley! Hmph.
lines.stormed_off: No-show? Then I win by default. Boring.

lines.great: The lanterns glow and the tent is fine! I'm a hero!
lines.poor: One lantern lit... and a small tent. Mostly fine.
lines.refused: Oh. I'll just watch from the hill, then.
lines.stormed_off: Too many people... I'll fly home.

lines.great: Phew! No sneezes! I even danced. Badly.
lines.poor: Ah... AHH... the Guild tent is a bit toasty now.
lines.refused: Then I'd better leave before I... ahh...
lines.stormed_off: AHH-CHOO! Oh no. Oh no. I'm so sorry!

lines.great: Balanced. Perfect. By Guild authority: licence granted!
lines.poor: So close. The Guild cannot grant a licence for close.
lines.refused: You refuse the final test? Then no licence.
lines.stormed_off: The judges leave. No potion, no licence.

lines.great: Against the odds: splendid! Licence granted!
lines.poor: Not enough, I'm afraid. No licence this year.
lines.refused: No potion, no licence. I'm sorry.
lines.stormed_off: Time's up. The Guild's verdict: no licence.
